steps.name: publish
argv:
# THE STEP THIS JOB EXISTS TO NOT REPEAT. ep2-cnet-probe-0817 rendered
# all four of its arms on 2026-08-17 and was invisible for two days
# because it had no step like this one: it declared artifacts under its
# own working directory and nothing ever carried them to farm-out, which
# is the only path by which a box result reaches the repo. box_enqueue
# now REFUSES a spec without one (courier_problems, 2026-08-19), and
# this job is the first filed through that guard.
#
# THE GLOBS NAME THE FILES EXACTLY. A glob that matches nothing publishes
# nothing while exiting 0, which is what made six rendered plates read as
# six failures on 2026-08-14. No allow_fail, and the count is asserted.
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
out_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/b08cnetplate-0819/out"
src_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/b08cnetplate-0819/src"
pay_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/b08cnetplate-0819"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b08-cnetplate-0819"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
files = sorted(glob.glob(out_dir + "/ep2-b08-cnetplate-0819-hint.png*")
               + glob.glob(out_dir + "/ep2-b08-cnetplate-0819-nocontrol.png*")
               + glob.glob(src_dir + "/pipeline/control/b08-pose-0819.png")
               + glob.glob(pay_dir + "/prompt.txt")
               + glob.glob(pay_dir + "/negative.txt"))
lines = []
for f in files:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b08-cnetplate-0819.sha256"), "w",
          newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(sorted(lines)) + "\n")
print("published", len(files), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(files) >= 7 else 1)
